system.description:
You master the unpredictable arcs and entangling chains of flail weapons, making every swing a threat from unexpected angles. Weapons that qualify for this stance are known as Reaper Weapons. You gain the following benefits;

When a creature within your weapons range misses you with an attack, you can spend your reaction to make an Attack of opportunity against them.

Once per turn, when you make a weapon attack or a melee Taijutsu attack using a Reaper Weapon, you can replace one attack with a Reaping Swing.

Reaping Swing. Make a weapon attack against a creature. On a hit, deal your [Weapon Damage] and force them to make a Dexterity saving throw vs your Taijutsu save DC. On a failure, their DR is reduced by 2 until the start of your next turn.

Beginning at 5th level, when you make an attack of opportunity as a result of a creature missing you with an attack, while using this stance, you can replace that attack with a Reaping Swing.

Beginning at 10th level, the DR penalty from Reaping Swing increases to 4. Additionally, as part of using Reaping Swing, you can select up to 3 creatures weapons range, and have the attack affect each of these spaces. If a creature is in the chosen space, compare the attack result to their AC, treating it as a successful hit on a success
